opportunities.name: Daybreak Attack Window
opportunities.objective: Count actual attacks within Q stun and separate personal items from allied Sunlight.
opportunities.mechanic: Q empowers the next attack with stun and AP magic. E roots/dashes and enables Q; Nashor/Dusk tests actual follow-up attacks within the stun. Riftmaker/health supports staying close through W, without claiming Leona can consume Sunlight herself.
opportunities.requiredState: Reach with E and perform Q attack plus follow-ups under W.
opportunities.failure: Solo damage is weak without allied P consumption and attack build sacrifices team defense.
opportunities.test: Count actual attacks within Q stun and separate personal items from allied Sunlight; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Dusk repetition does not automatically double Q stun or Sunlight marks.

opportunities.name: Eclipse Extension Pressure
opportunities.objective: Compare survival with W explosion hit versus miss under equal pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: W grants armor/MR partly scaling with bonus resists and extends those bonuses when the explosion hits. Sunfire/Unending Despair reward maintaining contact through E/Q control; Mandate uses those actual immobilizations to support allies while Randuin keeps attackers close.
opportunities.requiredState: W explosion must hit and allied damage occurs during Mandate vulnerability.
opportunities.failure: Missed explosion loses extension; mixed aura items may not repay lost immediate utility.
opportunities.test: Compare survival with W explosion hit versus miss under equal pressure; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W retaining resists does not retain its flat damage reduction unless confirmed live.

ruledOut.reason: P explicitly requires other allied champions to consume its mark.

unknowns: P duration differs between summary 1.5 seconds and engine 2.5 seconds; W flat-reduction extension behavior needs observation.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Daybreak Attack Window
builds.summary: Count actual attacks within Q stun and separate personal items from allied Sunlight.
builds.goal: Count actual attacks within Q stun and separate personal items from allied Sunlight.
builds.hypothesis: Q empowers the next attack with stun and AP magic. E roots/dashes and enables Q; Nashor/Dusk tests actual follow-up attacks within the stun. Riftmaker/health supports staying close through W, without claiming Leona can consume Sunlight herself.
testPlan: Required state: Reach with E and perform Q attack plus follow-ups under W.
Count actual attacks within Q stun and separate personal items from allied Sunlight; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Solo damage is weak without allied P consumption and attack build sacrifices team defense.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Dusk repetition does not automatically double Q stun or Sunlight marks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Leona's abilities mark enemies for [2.5] seconds. Other allied champions consume the mark when they damage the marked enemy, dealing an additional [characterLevelTable[25, 32, 39, 46, 53, 60, 67, 74, 81, 88, 95, 102, 109, 116, 123, 130, 137, 144, 151, 158, 165, 172, 179, 186, 193, 200, 207, 214, 221, 228, 235]] magic damage.
Leona's next Attack Stuns for [1] seconds and deals an additional [10 / 35 / 60 / 85 / 110 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage.
Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing [50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage. The last champion struck will be Rooted for [0.5] seconds and Leona will dash to them.

Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by [8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24] and gaining [20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50 + (0.2) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2]] Armor and [20 / 27.5 / 35 / 42.5 / 50 + (0.2) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] Magic Resist for [3] seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing [55 / 85 / 115 / 145 / 175 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional [3] seconds.
